items.briefing:
Security researchers are warning that cyber exploits are appearing faster than software patches can be released, meaning organisations face a growing window of risk even when they act quickly. A critical flaw in GitLab requires urgent attention as it can be triggered without any user interaction, making it particularly dangerous. Separately, a threat called "TwinLoot" is quietly stealing data by operating entirely through Microsoft's own cloud services, making it harder to detect.

Australian staff using Microsoft Copilot should also be aware that attackers have demonstrated ways to trick AI assistants into revealing sensitive system information. **Tip:** Ensure GitLab is updated immediately, and review what information you share with AI tools at work.

featured.title: Rapid7 says exploits are emerging faster than patches
